declaration.preface:
Background: This policy supersedes all the policies issued previously and all the subsequent amendments stand cancelled & substituted by this policy.

In India, there is currently no legally mandated or universally accepted living wage standard issued by the Government that is applicable across all industries and regions. Employers are generally required to comply with statutory minimum wage requirements as prescribed by the relevant Central and State Government authorities.

Jay Finechem Private Limited fully complies with all applicable minimum wage regulations. In addition, recognizing the growing importance of living wages in international sustainability and responsible business practices, the Company has established its own Living Wage Framework. This framework is developed by considering recognized living wage methodologies, regional cost-of-living factors, industry practices, and relevant international standards.

The Company's living wage assessment is intended to supplement statutory minimum wage requirements and provide a structured approach for evaluating whether employee compensation supports a reasonable standard of living. The assessment does not replace legal wage obligations and shall be reviewed periodically to reflect changes in economic conditions, inflation, and applicable standards.

Introduction: At Jay Finechem Private Limited, we recognize that a living wage is essential for the well-being of our employees and their families. It covers basic needs like food, shelter, and healthcare, enabling employees to contribute to society. This policy ensures all employees receive a living wage reflecting regional costs, promoting fair compensation and reinforcing our commitment to ethical labor practices and social responsibility.
declaration.declaration: At Jay Finechem Private Limited, we are committed to providing all employees with a living wage that goes beyond legal minimums to ensure a dignified standard of living. This includes covering essential needs such as housing, food, healthcare, and education. We regularly review and adjust wages based on regional cost-of-living data and inflation, ensuring transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Our approach addresses wage disparities across roles and regions, aligns with local and international labor laws, and supports our broader commitment to ethical labor practices, employee well-being, and long-term financial sustainability.
declaration.scope:
This Living Wage Policy applies universally to all employees of Jay Finechem Private Limited, including full-time, part-time, temporary, and contract workers. Furthermore, it extends to all suppliers, contractors, and partners within our supply chain. This Policy Applies to all operation facilities of Jay Finechem.

Effective Date: 1st January, 2024

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
At Jay Finechem Private Limited, we recognize that a living wage is essential for the well-being of our employees and their families. It covers basic needs like food, shelter, and healthcare, enabling employees to contribute to society.

The living wage assessment shall consider the following factors: Cost of nutritious food sufficient for a worker and their family; Cost of decent housing, including rent, utilities, and basic household expenses; Healthcare expenses, including preventive and essential medical care; Education costs for dependent children; Transportation expenses required for daily living and work; Clothing and other essential personal needs; Provision for unforeseen events and discretionary income.

Jay Finechem Private Limited shall calculate and periodically review living wage levels using internationally recognized living wage methodologies and applicable local regulations.

The Company may use one or more of the following recognized standards and methodologies when determining living wage benchmarks: Applicable national and state government wage regulations and notifications; Other credible and internationally recognized living wage assessment methodologies where relevant.

The living wage shall be assessed by comparing: Living Wage Gap = Calculated Living Wage Benchmark – Actual Compensation

For the purpose of assessment, compensation may include basic wages, fixed allowances, and other regular guaranteed cash benefits, in accordance with the selected living wage methodology.

The Company's living wage assessment is intended to supplement statutory minimum wage requirements and provide a structured approach for evaluating whether employee compensation supports a reasonable standard of living. The assessment does not replace legal wage obligations.

The Company shall review living wage calculations at least annually, or whenever significant changes occur in inflation rates, cost of living, statutory wage requirements, or business operating conditions.

Where gaps are identified between actual wages and the applicable living wage benchmark, the Company shall develop and implement reasonable improvement plans, considering legal requirements, business sustainability, and stakeholder expectations.

Ensure compensation practices support employee retention, motivation, and engagement while maintaining financial sustainability and organizational growth objectives.
Strengthen decision-making processes for compensation adjustments by incorporating performance, experience, and market trends in a transparent manner.
Transparent Wage Framework: Develop and maintain a clearly defined wage calculation methodology incorporating cost of living, inflation, and employee family needs considerations.
Ensure transparent communication of compensation structures enabling employees to understand how wages are determined and periodically revised.
Conduct awareness sessions and internal communications to improve employee understanding of wage policies and compensation frameworks.
Encourage open dialogue between employees and management regarding wage structures, concerns, and continuous improvement opportunities.
Employee Well-Being: Support employee financial stability by ensuring wages adequately contribute to meeting essential living needs and improving overall quality of life.
Complement wage structures with benefits such as healthcare, insurance, and social security provisions enhancing employee well-being and security.
Promote initiatives that enhance financial literacy and awareness among employees to support better financial planning and long-term stability.
Encourage programs that address broader socio-economic needs of employees contributing to sustained engagement and organizational productivity.
Legal Compliance: Implement a regular audit system to review compliance with local and international labor laws, ensuring we stay updated on legal changes.
Regularly monitor regulatory developments to update wage policies and practices in alignment with evolving legal and compliance obligations.
Include conducting regular training for HR and management teams on new labor laws and best practices in wage compliance.
Conduct periodic compliance audits to verify adherence to wage laws and identify potential risks or non-compliance areas proactively.
Maintain accurate and transparent records of wage payments and statutory benefits in accordance with legal and regulatory expectations.

targets.target: Maintain 100% of employees receiving a living wage, ensuring compliance with updated benchmarks and cost-of-living adjustments.
Ensure 100% of newly hired employees are onboarded with wages aligned to defined living wage benchmarks from their joining date.
Ensure 100% of employees are covered under the Company's living wage benchmark assessment and analysis
Ensure 100% of employees are paid at or above the Company's established living wage benchmark
Our target is to ensure that 90% of employees are within 5% of the market median salary
Our goal is to align 95% of wage adjustments with inflation rates and performance based metrics
We aim for 100% compliance with local labor laws
Our goal is to ensure that 80% of employees have a clear understanding of how their wages are determined
